database_direction: 参考Render托管PostgreSQL18、10GB；15业务表＋1迁移元数据表。实际账号/资源/小版本/TLS连接与账单仍未取得或部署
authority_rules: HostCallContext/执行授权由实际认证Host注入，不从请求解析
普通Agent不获网关回执/观测接纳入口
人工允许接单与设备报告允许接单分开；有效资格还需新鲜度及模型约束
不存在公网任意修改库存/完成作业的端点
read_cloud_production仅为明确只读选择；Renderer/MCP请求不能注入云凭据、URL或方法；读授权不导出网关权限
网关为Native内部受管actor，真实私有Gateway上下文由Native注册；不经普通Agent管道冒充UI
telemetry_only与generated_load分数据集，不能进入执行会话或增加接受量
观测probe由原活跃Host创建并在实际H07接纳时核对；普通Agent/云端/device不能填写Host发起/接纳时刻或续期
原始/过期/重复遥测保留云查询；只有收到probe后新采样且在原Host期限内接纳的回应，才能更新Host设备资格；失效不释放原生产义务

consistency_boundary.cloud_owner: 原始数据、命令及只读投影持久化
consistency_boundary.live_epoch_effects: 同回执在存活epoch内只有一次Engine效果及稳定接纳结果
consistency_boundary.crash: 未知epoch保留slot与原命令，等待明确核对
consistency_boundary.publication_delivery_state: 位于业务Snapshot之外；本地确认/云同步待完成可并存；最终三材料演示需核对已发布修订

host_operations.name: start_execution_session
host_operations.semantics: 冻结输入并登记准备Task；云占位和准备在Host锁外；成功仅得到prepared会话，准备期不派工

host_operations.name: get_execution_snapshot
host_operations.semantics: 读取本机实际持有的latest/revision/cutoff快照（含只读执行归档）；原Engine所有权另判，缺失不退回云旧快照

host_operations.name: control_execution_session
host_operations.semantics: 比较expected_execution_revision；人工允许接单与设备报告接单状态分开

host_operations.name: apply_device_receipt
host_operations.semantics: Host赋接纳序号及时间；云存储成功不等于生产提交；普通Agent不获此入口

host_operations.name: get_execution_cloud_work
host_operations.semantics: 只读待发布指令、快照和撤回；读取不产生第二次工作

host_operations.name: acknowledge_execution_cloud_work
host_operations.semantics: 按work_id核对原云提交；只确认同步状态，不生成生产事实

host_operations.name: apply_device_observation
host_operations.semantics: 仅在run启动时钟后的可观察会话接纳有效新设备观测及新鲜度；prepared不伪造运行接纳；不直接完成作业或释放资源

host_operations.name: read_cloud_production
host_operations.principal: scoped reader/operator, selection and project authorized by Host
host_operations.semantics: 本机配置只返回脱敏绑定；其余只读选择经凭据保管的Host worker访问C07/C08/C12/C13/C14/C15，不在Host锁内网络I/O；不接受任意URL/方法/凭据

host_operations.name: read_execution_view
host_operations.principal: scoped reader/operator exact local execution data
host_operations.semantics: 只读本机inputs、固定R/F/T观察、固定history、本调用者原请求Task或真实本机catalog；无云I/O/生产效果

host_operations.name: export_execution_report
host_operations.principal: authorized exporter exact Project and SelectedFileRef purpose
host_operations.semantics: 固定1或2个源的R/F与冻结输入/连续历史，构造同一ExecutionReport供PDF/HTML/CSV/JSON；真实Task原子写选定目录，取消不停止生产

host_operations.name: export_cloud_data
host_operations.principal: authorized Project exporter + cloud read scope + own SelectedFileRef purpose
host_operations.semantics: 固定查询F/设备集合或执行revision，从头逐页CSV/JSONL写入新目录；真实Task提交后返文件；取消只作用于导出

cloud_operations.request: exact command path and authorized session/device

tables.name: cloud_projects
constraints: ProjectId不是认证依据；云项目范围由服务端身份解析

tables.name: project_execution_slots
constraints: 同云项目最多一个活动/待核对占位
不能只因超时释放

tables.name: execution_sessions
constraints: 会话/epoch/输入及策略不可改写；live dataset反向引用本行避免循环FK

tables.name: datasets
constraints: purpose=execution时session非null且每会话唯一；telemetry_only/generated_load时session为null；purpose与source_mode组合由部署配置固定
普通事务字段计数器与事件一起提交；不得把bigserial当提交前沿

tables.name: device_bindings
constraints: unique(project_id,device_id)
映射与Host冻结模型一致；项目数据不保存明文凭据

tables.name: commands
constraints: unique(session_id,logical_job_id,phase_id,attempt_ordinal)
partial unique(session_id,logical_job_id,phase_id) WHERE closed_by_host_at IS NULL
同CommandId不同typed payload冲突，不做覆盖式UPSERT
发布及领取须命中同会话/epoch的active boot；原command的目标boot不可更换

tables.name: device_poll_requests
columns: observation_probe:jsonb nullable; original poll response copy
constraints: 包括empty/command及probe在内的原响应不可变；同poll身份不同typed请求冲突
accept_commands=false只返回观测probe及empty，不领取命令；同poll不能刷新probe
probe取当时同session/epoch/boot的已发布精确快照，不由云端时间生成或续期；退役boot仅可读原poll结果

tables.name: device_events
columns: command_id:text nullable; receipt payload only, matching typed payload
constraints: unique(dataset_id,ingress_id)
live partial unique(device_binding_id,device_boot_id,device_sequence)；telemetry_only同样去重但不产生Host接纳
load unique(dataset_id,batch_id,batch_ordinal)及unique(dataset_id,device_ref,device_sequence)
原始存储本身不增加生产接受量
receipt rows command_id matches immutable typed command identity; telemetry has null command_id

tables.name: receipt_admissions
constraints: 引用已存live event；同revision结果不可变
解决先前依赖产生新的执行修订；与对应快照同时发布

tables.name: execution_snapshots
constraints: 不可变完整Host投影，含attempt/接纳前缀；不混入generated负载

tables.name: execution_heads
constraints: 组合FK指向精确快照；CAS比较expected_published_revision
可跳到较新revision，但必须携带完整自洽投影

tables.name: execution_cutoffs
constraints: 组合FK指向不可变截止快照；迟到回执不改该引用

tables.name: execution_inputs
constraints: immutable typed input documents and asset manifest; no credentials or Engine checkpoint
C01 top identity/input/policy/candidate fields must match frozen bundle and actual Engine capture

tables.name: execution_observations
constraints: typed payload identity matches indexed kind/id
record identity immutable; identical replay accepted, differing payload conflicts
record_sequence is gap-free through published snapshot observation_frontier
no FK to each intermediate snapshot revision; coalesced publication may skip snapshot rows while preserving all observation records

tables.name: device_boots
constraints: partial unique(device_binding_id) WHERE state=active
同boot的会话/epoch不可变；retired不复活，不按TTL替换active
retire仅在对应已发布终态/命令结清下由gateway请求；退役修订固定

tables.name: schema_migrations
constraints: 只在TX13成功完成15业务表/约束/种子后同事务写version1
仅部署元数据，不是业务事件/Host修订；不增加checksum或通用迁移框架

transactions.purpose: 发布Host快照、接纳结果与观察前缀
steps: 锁session/head并校验epoch和expected published revision
同snapshot revision只比较不可变snapshot；重复观察record逐身份比较typed内容
新增记录必须从已确认观察前沿连续延伸到snapshot.observation_frontier，记录修订/时间不得超过本快照

cursor_design.telemetry: rows: fixed dataset/normalized UTC filter/frontier + after_ingress_id; aggregate: fixed grouping over same frontier + after_row_index; each page including empty/last stamps dataset_id and selected_visible_frontier; aggregate after_row_index=null is before first row0; raw start after_ingress_id=0; normalized query devices resolve at F and each result echoes selected_device_ids
cursor_design.execution: identity/query with page.cursor=null + fixed snapshot revision + after_row_index
cursor_design.selection: server compares normalized typed filter and identity, then rechecks authorization; cursor is untrusted data and never a grant; telemetry requires F<=current committed frontier and valid positional bounds; unsigned cursor cannot attest its original issuing query, only an authorized prefix; consumer compares original response selection
cursor_design.ordering: raw telemetry uses committed dataset ingress; grouped telemetry uses bucket/device/source-mode order; execution uses fixed snapshot typed row vector
cursor_design.canonical_rows: kind order then stable identity/phase/attempt or fixed snapshot event ordinal; row_index is stable for this fixed selection
cursor_design.command_receipts: CommandReceiptsCursor binds authorized identity/command and fixed dataset committed frontier; ordered ingress_id, limit<=200; never broad gateway event read permission
cursor_design.execution_observations: ExecutionObservationCursor pins exact revision, time, object selection and observation_frontier; stable item/job/device/logical_work/attempt + object-id rows, limit<=200
cursor_design.execution_history: fixed identity/R/F/range/object selection; original record_sequence order, inclusive point-time endpoints, limit<=200; no cursor or request id as authorization

device_registration: 固定部署配置保存binding/主体/动作；C19登记每次执行boot，C13给原slot boot目录，C20结清退役。无通用注册UI；不同active boot不可抢占。
identity_mapping: Native project_id为本地ProjectId；HTTP路径project_id为云项目身份；服务端显式映射并校验owner_scope/local_project_id，禁止仅凭字符串相同授权

prepare_ready: H01经Native受管后端完成冻结归档、C01、两自有子进程存活及C19/C13精确boot确认、r0观察/快照发布后才prepared；prepared仍无运行时钟/派工。部分启动取消按stopped前缀→空闲子进程退出→C20→C10结清；未知结果保留原占位。
request_lookup: H01/H08/H10/H11登记Task与原request_id索引同一Host短事务完成；键为实际Host/调用者/Project/request_id。H09只读原调用者登记；同身份同typed params返回原Task，不同params冲突。索引不声称跨Host重启幂等；not_found不授权重新生产；H11同原Host/调用者/Project/request_id索引；第四registered操作分支，实际get_task输出cloud_data_export

observation_freshness.transport: Host rN ExecutionDeviceView.pending_observation_probe -> C06/TX06 -> C03/TX03 immutable poll result -> fresh C04 sample -> H07
observation_freshness.host_authority: live original session/epoch/boot outstanding probe registry; no reconstruction from cloud/archive
observation_freshness.acceptance: strict host_now_ms < probe.expires_at_host_ms and exact not-yet-consumed probe; duplicate original response returns original admission and original deadline
observation_freshness.publication: probe.issued_at<=snapshot observed time; issued revision<=published revision; expiry may be future declared deadline, not an observed event
observation_freshness.unknown_or_rejected: raw receipt remains queryable; cannot reset latest qualified proof, eligibility or expiry

operational_endpoints.response: 204 empty when schema1/config/pool SELECT1 ready; otherwise503 empty
operational_endpoints.principal: public/platform readiness probe, no project data

cloud_time_rule.storage: timestamptz(6); DB clock_timestamp sampled once after dataset lock and dedup for each new TX04 event/TX10 batch
cloud_time_rule.retry: exact retry retains first timestamp; ingress is commit order, timestamps are not guaranteed monotonic
cloud_time_rule.query: received_from <= cloud_received_at < received_until; equal is empty; inverted is422; timestamps normalized to UTC
cloud_time_rule.aggregate: only telemetry/generated_load; UTC minute; emit nonempty groups; stable bucket/device/source order; row_index starts0
cloud_time_rule.filter: device_ids sorted/deduplicated; [] means all authorized devices in selected dataset; explicit out-of-scope403; authorized no matching rows is empty
cloud_time_rule.source_time: GeneratedLoadEvent.observed_at is synthetic sender time; never overwrite DB time or Host monotonic time
cloud_time_rule.device_membership: [] resolves authorized device refs present in telemetry/generated_load at fixed F, sorted; explicit authorized ids retained without matching rows; every result returns resolved selected_device_ids, cursor normalized selection binds set; scope change cannot silently change pages
